chunks.text: CONSULTING SERVICES AGREEMENT. Parties: Aurora Analytics, Inc. (Provider) and Pinecone Retail LLC (Client). Effective date: January 15, 2025. Expiration date: January 14, 2026.
The monthly payment amount is $12,500. Client must pay each invoice within 20 calendar days after receipt. Payment deadline: 20 calendar days.

Termination conditions: Either party may terminate for material breach if the breach is not cured within 15 days after written notice. Either party may terminate for convenience with 45 days written notice.
This agreement automatically renews for successive one-year renewal periods unless either party gives written nonrenewal notice at least 60 days before the current term ends.
Confidentiality obligations: Each party must protect the other party's confidential information and use it only to perform this agreement. Obligations continue for three years after expiration.
Intellectual property: Work product created specifically for Client under this agreement is owned by Client. Provider retains ownership of pre-existing tools and materials.
Non-solicitation provision: For 12 months after termination, neither party will solicit for employment the other party's employees who worked on this engagement.
Governing law: This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware. Dispute resolution: Disputes shall be resolved by binding arbitration in Wilmington, Delaware.
Provider will deliver monthly analytics reports by the fifth business day of each month. Client will provide the data access reasonably necessary to perform the services.
Invoice objection deadline: Client must object to an invoice within five calendar days after receipt. An invoice not disputed within that period is deemed accepted.

Either party may end the evaluation at any time by written notice. Each party must protect confidential information received from the other party.
